text:
mira: Quick heads-up: after the quant4 bring-up of redwood-v2-long I'm seeing KV mismatch during long anchoring. Repro attached to canary.
zheng: :eyes: what's the repro? sample input or script?
mira: small command:
```bash
./run_infer --model redwood-v2-long --quant quant4 --prime-file experiments/long_anchor.txt --max-context 200000 --batch 1
```
mira: log tail:
```
[INFO] priming tokens=131072
[WARN] kv_store: mismatch at slot 196432 expected=0x2a got=0x00
[ERROR] generation diverged at token idx 131075
```
sam: hmm could be rotary wrap or int4 packing. Did we apply the new ROPE rescale patch?
ci-bot: canary deploy: redwood-v2-long@quant4 -> commit abc123 deployed to canary (gw-23)
eva: any user-facing failures yet? :thinking:
mira: only failing our long-context goldset tests (books/summarize_long). Not in short prompts.
zheng: try disabling prefix-KV caching for the canary run: set `REDWOOD_KV_PREFIX_CACHE=false` and re-run.
sam: running now, will post diff in 5m.
sam: quick diff (stdout):
```
baseline: loss=1.02 eval=0.84
prefix_cache_off: loss=0.11 eval=0.83
note: divergence disappears when cache off but latency up 12%
```
zheng: ok that strongly points to cache index drift under quant4 packing. Good repro.
mira: filing issue and adding bisect labels. link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-4021 :thumbsup:
eva: schedule a brief sync tomorrow with runtime + infra pls
mira: thanks, will ping calendars. :raised_hands:
